discoveries.Title: Arrival
discoveries.Text: The valley was quieter than the maps suggested. Even the wind seemed to be listening for something.

discoveries.Title: The Rain Garden
discoveries.Text: Green, against all odds, and tended by someone who hasn't given up on it.

discoveries.Title: The Wind Cliffs
discoveries.Text: Beacons in a row, unlit, facing a sea that stopped sending anything worth warning about.

discoveries.Title: The Amber Shore
discoveries.Text: Glass in the sand, warm to the touch even in shade. Someone left in a hurry, or slowly enough not to notice leaving.

discoveries.Title: The Archive
discoveries.Text: Stairs down, into a room that smells like paper and salt.

discoveries.Title: The Rain Garden's Name
discoveries.Text: Fragment recovered: the garden was once called Amaranth Hollow.

discoveries.Title: The Wind Cliffs' Name
discoveries.Text: Fragment recovered: the cliffs were once called The Cliffwatch.

discoveries.Title: The Amber Shore's Name
discoveries.Text: Fragment recovered: the shore was once called Tern's Landing.

discoveries.Title: A Pattern in the Wilting
discoveries.Text: The driest plot always wants water first. Read the wilt, not the guesswork.

discoveries.Title: The Cartographer's Task
discoveries.Text: The Cartographer wants the map finished before their memory of the old names fades entirely.

discoveries.Title: The Gardener's Patience
discoveries.Text: The Gardener stayed for the garden, not despite it. They want it to matter to someone else, too.

discoveries.Title: The Watcher's Vigil
discoveries.Text: The Watcher has kept this duty alone for years, waiting to be relieved of it by someone who understands why it mattered.

discoveries.Title: The Scattering
discoveries.Text: The valley didn't empty all at once. The drought took the garden first, then the cliffwatch lost its purpose, and people left one boat at a time.

discoveries.Title: The Archivist's Duty
discoveries.Text: The Archivist keeps the full record even believing most of it will never be read again — until now.

discoveries.Title: The Last Page
discoveries.Text: The lantern-keeper's own hand: they didn't leave because they stopped caring. They left because they were the only one left who remembered how to say goodbye properly, and it took every name they knew to do it.

discoveries.Title: The Central Lantern
discoveries.Text: Dark, for now. The valley's namesake, waiting.

discoveries.Title: The Sanded Signpost
discoveries.Text: Three roads out of the hub, and a post sanded smooth of names — deliberately, it looks like.

discoveries.Title: The Dry Fountain
discoveries.Text: Hasn't run in years. Still, someone sweeps the leaves from the basin.

discoveries.Title: The Weathervane
discoveries.Text: Turns true. It's been pointing at something for a long time.

discoveries.Title: The Rope Bridge
discoveries.Text: Tight on two posts, slack on the middle one. Whatever it held once isn't there anymore.

discoveries.Title: The Watch Tower
discoveries.Text: Built for watching the sea for something that, as far as anyone can tell, never came back.

discoveries.Title: The Shipwreck
discoveries.Text: Half-buried, and long since given up on.

discoveries.Title: The Tide-Glass Altar
discoveries.Text: Three empty settings, worn smooth by salt and hands.
